_description: Reference/template for every JASE CLI parameter (src/main.cpp), grouped the same way as --help's own sections. Not consumed by JASE itself (no --settings loader exists yet) -- hand values from here to the actual `./jase ...` invocation. null/false/[] means 'flag omitted'.

machine._description: Machine selection -- must be decided before anything else; --machine picks the ROM that boots.

media._description: Tape/snapshot/cartridge content to stage or load at startup.

peripherals._description: Optional hardware add-ons. Each *Rom/*Bridge value implies enabling its own peripheral even if "enabled" is left false.

debugging._description: Debug-protocol server, pre-boot memory/port pokes, and instruction/bus tracing.

_examples._description: A few full settings snapshots actually used during 2026-10-31/11-01 Dandanator+Multiply sessions, for reference.
